findings.claim: confirmExecuteAnyway has no guard against being triggered twice; unlike handleConfirmPress which checks isExecuting, a double tap on "Execute anyway" before the sheet closes can send two relay requests, both with acceptUnverifiedSimulation: true. A synchronous ref guard shared with runExecution should be added.

retryWithAcceptUnverified calls execute(true) without awaiting or catching it, and since execute re-throws, any failure becomes an unhandled promise rejection; the existing retry function has the same problem and this change copies it.

The new return fields simulationError and retryWithAcceptUnverified are only used in the hook's own test file, while the real flow goes through useExecutionFlow.confirmExecuteAnyway instead, leaving two parallel retry APIs; they should either be removed or wired up.

The new Safe-pays logic has no tests: the effect that forces relay, the terminal RelayUnavailableSheet branch, and the hidden signer list and divider are all untested, and there is no test file for this container at all.

The terminal state rendered when requiresRelay && !isRelayEnabled is untested; existing tests cover the pure helper functions txRequiresRelay and getExecutionMethod but not this rendering branch, and neither new sheet component has a test.
The new safePaidFee branch, which decides whether to show "amount · fee" when the gas token differs from the transfer token, has no test; the existing test only covers the pure builder function.

Two different ways to find the transfer token address were added in the same change: FeesBreakdown uses a loosely typed transferTokenAddress helper taking a Record<string, unknown>, while TokenTransfer.tsx uses the existing isERC20Transfer guard; both should use isERC20Transfer, and both files also duplicate the same native-currency object construction ({ address: ZERO_ADDRESS, symbol, decimals }).

IndeterminateSimulationSheet and RelayUnavailableSheet are nearly identical (same BottomSheetModal setup, badge, title, text and button layout) and differ only in icon theme, copy and buttons; a single configurable alert sheet could cover both, similar to how ReadOnlyWarningModal and SoftUpdatePrompt already repeat this pattern.

useTokenDetails(transfer ?? ({ transferInfo: {} } as never)) passes a fake object with an as never cast to bypass the type system, which has the same risk as using any; the hook should instead accept an optional argument or support being skipped.

txRequiresRelay is imported from another feature's internals (features/ExecuteTx/components/ReviewAndExecute/helpers) even though it is a pure check with no component dependency; it could move to packages/utils alongside isGtfSafePaid or into a shared util.

The label "FREE" is rendered in all caps instead of sentence case; additionally, fees are now always shown on the confirm screen, a "Sending" label was added to the transfer header, and signer execution was removed for Safe-pays transactions, and these visible product changes should link to the product or design decision in the PR description.

Number(fiatConversion) converts an empty or whitespace-only string to 0, which passes the Number.isFinite check, so a price that is actually unknown would display as $0 instead of being omitted; an empty or trimmed-empty string should be treated as undefined.

fontSize={16} lineHeight={24} are hardcoded numeric values rather than Tamagui design tokens (e.g. fontSize="$4"), which the project's structure guidelines call for, though this raw-number pattern already exists elsewhere in the codebase.
